hook: First SPHEREx search for axion dark matter finds no signal and sets new limits on light coupling.
hook_turn: sets new limits on light coupling.
summary: Axion-like dark matter would decay into faint infrared light, so the team searched the first 16.5 months of SPHEREx spectra for it. They found no signal and set limits for masses of 0.496 to 3.32 eV that rival earlier ones. The analysis is deliberately conservative, and the authors say better methods could improve it by over ten times.
title: First constraints on axion-like particles with SPHEREx data
